name: Cloudflare for Startups Credits
free_limit: Approved tech startups may receive $10,000 (self-funded), $100,000 (eligible partner-backed), or up to $350,000 (higher-funded partner-backed) in one-time credits for eligible Workers, Workers AI, D1, R2, KV, Queues, Pages and related usage-based services, for up to one year.
watch_out: Approval depends on company age, funding, stage, public website, company email and other rules; the tier is not guaranteed. Credit coverage excludes registrar and AI Gateway; Workers AI has a $50,000 subcap and R2 a $10,000 subcap. A valid card is required, and automatic paid overage/expiry billing applies. Credits are one time and non-transferable.
